title: Soliton and breather interactions in the integrable discrete focusing Manakov system via Hirota's method
summary: The aim of this paper is to apply Hirota's bilinear method to the integrable discrete Manakov system in the focusing dispersion regime in order to construct and analyze soliton and breather solutions. After deriving the general bilinear form of the system, we show how to obtain fundamental solitons, as well as fundamental and composite breathers. We then obtain solutions exhibiting 2 solitons and 2 breathers and combinations of a soliton and a breather, and discuss all ``two-body'' interactions properties, with particular emphasis on explicit formulas, visualization, and long-time asymptotic…
